input.name: image
input.letterbox: aspect-preserving fit, centered, pad rgb(114,114,114); coords map back as (u*W - dx)/scale (see train/dataset.py letterbox_params)

output.name: maps
output.channels: 0: face-center heatmap logit (sigmoid me); 1..8: corner offsets x0,y0..x3,y3 in cells, relative to the cell center
output.decode: corner = ((j+0.5+offx)*stride/W, (i+0.5+offy)*stride/H); candidates are every cell >= threshold, strongest first (ties to the lower cell index), then drop a quad whose center is within 0.5 x an already-kept quad's mean edge (floor 8 px), keep 6; NOT a 3x3 max-pool - that dropped a face on small cubes. Quads are ANONYMOUS - name them by center color
output.cornerOrder: cyclic, winding consistent; starting corner arbitrary
